title: What can Topology tell us about Logical Complexity?
summary: In the 1980s, category theorists introduced the Lawvere-Tierney $(\leq_{\mathrm{LT}})$ order in the Effective Topos, known to effectively embed the Turing degrees. Understanding its structure is a longstanding open problem in the area. In particular, there was an informal sense that the $\leq_{\mathrm{LT}}$-order reflects certain shifts in combinatorial complexity, but a precise characterisation remained elusive for some time.
